# Cell-Free Opt

Cell-Free Opt: An AI optimizer for cell-free protein synthesis (CFPS) systems, suggesting ideal reagent concentrations to maximize protein yield.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Gaussian heuristic grid maximum 2.0 at documented reagent optima matches analytic bound and repeats. Not trained AI or actual yield optimization.

text: It simulates reaction kinetics and calculates costs for specific experimental setups.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Numeric kinetics and cost arithmetic exist; zero-hour 0.25 g/L defect recorded separately. Current vendor price truth not checked; no purchase recommendation.

text: Cell-Free Opt enables rapid prototyping of genetic designs without the limitations of living cells, providing a fast evaluation platform.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Simulation platform, no actual prototyping or validated genetic design performance.

# Organoid Screen

Organoid Screen: A virtual drug screening platform that tests compounds on patient-derived organoid models.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Curated tissue/drug response screening and separate structure-grounded interface; no validated patient-derived clinical model.

text: It predicts clinical efficacy and identifies biomarkers associated with drug response.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Legacy clinical_efficacy_prediction fixed IC50 function and marker lookup, not clinical efficacy/biomarker validation.

text: Organoid Screen visualizes interaction networks and calculates synergy scores, helping researchers identify the most effective and personalized treatment strategies using 3D biological models.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Network edges/Bliss expectation exist; actual visualization uninspected. Supplied measured combo utility reproduces .25 expectation/.15 excess; not personalized 3D efficacy.

# Vector Opt

Vector Opt: A structural modeling tool for fine-tuning viral vector capsids, simulating capsid-receptor docking to improve transduction efficiency.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Random region/mutation-count variant scoring, no coordinate or sequence docking. target_receptor inert and AAV2/AAV9 numeric output identical at same seed.

text: It predicts the impact of neutralizing antibodies and suggests modifications to enhance vector safety.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: Region flags and fixed/random loss proxy produce NAb/safety suggestions; actual neutralization and safety not measured.

text: Vector Opt enables the engineering of novel viral variants tailored for specific applications, overcoming common delivery barriers.
split_caveat: Automatic punctuation-based unit; abbreviations, formulas and compound sentences may require manual split/merge. No semantic pass implied.
evidence_and_limit: IDs and region counts not engineered full capsid sequences; real delivery barriers not overcome in evidence.

# Virtual Cell

Virtual Cell: A multi-scale simulator that integrates metabolic flux models with gene regulatory networks.

evidence_and_limit: ODE/Gillespie expression to enzyme flux caps and pFBA implemented; limited models, not whole-cell biological validation.
